properties.description: 6.63-acre vacant lot on desirable W Lake Road offering a rare opportunity to build, invest, or hold for future use. Enjoy a spacious setting with room to create your vision while staying close to Lake Erie, Fairview schools, local amenities, shopping, dining, and major routes. Whether you’re considering a future homesite, recreational space, or long-term land investment, this property offers flexibility and potential in a sought-after location. Seller indicates public utilities are for available for hookup, with a sewer connection that extends approximately 200 yards into the property. Wet lands further into property. Buyer to verify zoning, utilities, permitted uses, and development options. Bring your plans and explore the possibilities for your dream home on this prime development opportunity!
